steps.title: Open Trendora's home page
steps.narration: Let's start where every session begins — the home page, showing today's market regime at a glance.
steps.point_out: The regime card and score appear immediately, with no error banner or blank space.

steps.title: Check the Data Manager's status
steps.narration: Next, the Data Manager, where new market data arrives. A status badge in the top bar is visible on every page and always reflects the backend's real, current health.
steps.point_out: The badge reads "Ready" with a green dot — an honest, live signal, never a guess.

steps.title: See the latest completed data run
steps.narration: The Job progress panel keeps a summary of the most recent data run, even if you weren't the one who started it.
steps.point_out: The summary lists everything that was refreshed, including the forward-looking figures used on the Backtest page — computed once when the data arrived, never recalculated on the spot.

steps.title: Confirm it in Run history too
steps.narration: Scrolling down, the Run history table keeps a permanent record of every data run that has ever completed, even after a reload.
steps.point_out: That same run still shows a clean status here, with the same forward-looking figures confirmed a second, independent way.

steps.title: Try a wide historical date range
steps.narration: Back at the top of the Data Manager, the backfill form still accepts any historical range you like, with no hidden size limit.

steps.title: No range cap enforced
steps.narration: Even a span of more than a year is accepted without any warning or truncation.
steps.point_out: Notice there's no error message or size warning — just a normal, ready-to-submit form.

steps.title: Open the Backtest page
steps.narration: The Backtest page shows how a strategy would have performed historically, broken down by holding period. This round's work was all about keeping this exact page quick and correct even while other data work runs in the background.
steps.point_out: The full scorecard and evidence panel load with real numbers right away — no error card, no stuck loading skeleton.

steps.title: Spot-check Scanner Runs
steps.narration: One last stop — the Scanner Runs history, which lists every dated scan that has ever been saved.
steps.point_out: Past runs are still listed here with their full detail one click away, confirming this round's behind-the-scenes work didn't disturb anything else.
